name: ora-ops
description: Oxford Realty Advisors daily-automation logic, bundled as one-line slash commands. Each command is a thin pointer at the authoritative on-disk SKILL.md (or audit) spec, so a Claude Desktop scheduled task can run an entire routine from a single line. All five are manual-invoke-only (side-effecting) and preserve the firm's recipients, full python path, and Outlook send paths.
